Amir — thanks for the quick confirmation. Attaching the items we discussed. High level notes are below.

Attachments (included):
- SOC2-Type2-2026-Redwood.pdf (full report; sensitive)
- PenTest-Summary-Redwood.txt (executive summary only)
- Audit-Logs-Schema.csv (column definitions + sample row)
- Data-Retention-FAQ.docx (answers to DSAR, per-tenant retention, default windows)
- MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN-Blueleaf.xlsx (draft MAP mapping owners and dates)

Quick answers to your questions:
- Per-tenant retention: yes — configurable by customer and enforced at the tenant level for hosted/private deployments. See Data-Retention-FAQ (section 2).
- Default retention windows: logs (90 days), model inputs (30 days) by default; longer retention available on request/contract.
- DSAR: we support a documented DSAR flow for hosted customers; we can provide a runbook and SLA for responses (included in FAQ).

Next steps I propose (internal + external):
- Amir/Alex: sync to review artifacts — propose 30 min Tues 11/16 at 10:00am PT.
- Sean: will follow up with MAP updates and a short one-pager mapping our offerings to your decision criteria.
- Karthik: will stand by to answer any procurement/price-related questions and coordinate legal if needed.

If you need any redactions or an NDA to share the SOC 2 in your system, tell me and we can route that to legal.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
